title: The Broken Vows
text: A heap of holy vows written on ribbons lies in the mud of the Court's square, torn and trampled. The Court's new converts threw them there, laughing. Some of the handwriting is very careful. Some of the ribbons are still wet with tears.

options.label: Gather up the vows and keep them safe.

outcomes.text: The converts jeer and throw mud. Somewhere, the old saints are pleased.

options.label: The shrewdest reads whose vows they were.

outcomes.text: Names worth knowing, and the secrets they swore off.

options.label: Tear one of your own vows, to blend in.

outcomes.text: Through the Court as friends, smiling, and something inside each of you tears with the ribbon.
